title: Conditions to check for Invoices and Receipts

question.author: member_040
question.body: Could support clarify invoices and receipts in the current CloudBox version? I want to avoid relying on an outdated post.

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Billing and Plans documentation says: You can download PDF receipts for the last 24 months, change the billing email, and switch between credit card and bank transfer (Business and Enterprise). Failed payments trigger a 14-day grace period before access is limited to view/download-only mode. Invoices are issued monthly from the billing portal at the start of each cycle. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
